description: Plan renaming a content-type, component, service, controller, policy or middleware: every call-site and route handler, and the files. configSync.description: With config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views). Default: the user's setting, true unless turned off. false when config/sync isn't yours to change here. The warnings say which files.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

newName.description: The new last segment: item makes api::product.product api::product.item.
